standard-dialogue.npc: Be careful going in there! You are unarmed, and there is much evilness lurking down there! The evilness seems to block off our contact with our gods,
so our prayers seem to have less effect down there. Oh, also, you won't be able to come back this way - This ladder only goes one way!
The only exit from the caves below is a portal which leads only to the deepest wilderness!

options.text: I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.

steps.player: I don't think I'm strong enough to enter then.

options.text: Well that is a risk I will have to take.

steps.player: Well that is a risk I will have to take.
